title: Deeper/broader cross-project consumer abstraction and nested-block placement review
mode: primary-source repository/documentation and issue review with local plan reconciliation
scope: Assess current FreeCAD block-placement reports as downstream consumer evidence rather than libdxfrw defects
Refine the existing composed FreeCAD qualification around nested INSERT identity, transforms, backend and importer settings
Reconcile callback-only dxflib and geometry-conversion BRL-CAD routes against whole-document parity claims
Preserve fast local validation, scratch-only generated controls, and external support deferrals

method.limitations: Public main/documentation is mutable. FreeCAD issue #25451 attachments and claimed input were not downloaded or independently reproduced. The dxflib detailed guide is historical. BRL-CAD issue/PR details are peer-reported/proposed, not independently tested here.

evidence.topic: FreeCAD #25451 is a downstream block-placement lead
observed: The issue is open and carries a Confirmed label.
The report says some blocks are missing or misplaced in both C++ and legacy Python DXF import paths and multiple Import As modes.
The reporter identifies FreeCAD 1.0.2 as reproducible and supplies a 1.2.0dev build identity with commit be7d41dea75f7f2966d7b431d24f7060c6907339.
The attached source DXF and result document were not downloaded; no expected block transform manifest was present in the reviewed body.
doesNotEstablish: A matching libdxfrw parser or writer defect
Whether the original DXF, the selected importer, or object grouping/display caused each reported symptom
General behavior of every FreeCAD release, importer backend, platform, or setting
evidence.planUse: At the existing composed consumer gate only, use a locally generated nested INSERT control with nonzero block base, asymmetric child geometry, and independently computed composed transforms. Record backend/mode/settings and object grouping separately from expected geometry. Do not use the attached file as a fixture.

evidence.topic: FreeCAD DWG and DXF importer routes must remain separate
observed: The application workflow uses an external DWG converter before the selected DXF importer.
The C++ and legacy Python DXF importer routes and their feature/settings surfaces differ.
A converter handoff or successful file-open does not establish the imported block geometry.
evidence.planUse: Keep direct DXF import separate from DWG→converter→DXF→FreeCAD; record converter identity, exit status, fresh intermediate DXF hash/version, backend, settings, and geometry disposition.

evidence.topic: dxflib is callback-oriented rather than a whole-document parity model
observed: The detailed guide says the reader dispatches supported entities/objects to consumer callbacks and does not store an entity/document model.
The detailed guide dates to 2004–2005 and does not establish a current complete entity/version matrix.
evidence.planUse: Retain as an optional callback/2D probe only; score the exact adapter's callbacks and values, not document identity/owner preservation.

evidence.topic: BRL-CAD dxf-g/g-dxf is a lossy geometry conversion route with an unresolved hostile-PFACE report
observed: The tutorial describes polygons/meshes becoming BOT, layers becoming regions, lines/circles/arcs becoming NMG, points becoming spheres, and absent units defaulting to millimeters with scale/tolerance options.
The inverse g-dxf path is documented as faceted output, with 3DFACE default and POLYFACE available via -p.
Issue #228 reports an out-of-bounds POLYFACE face-index read in dxf-g; proposed PR #245 was still open in the inspected public view and was not independently built or reviewed.
evidence.planUse: Keep BRL-CAD as an optional explicit-facet geometry projection, not identity/owner parity. Do not send malformed PFACE input until a merged immutable fix is checked for bounds, signed visibility, and the zero terminator.

nextActions: At the existing composed FreeCAD checkpoint, run one locally generated nested-INSERT placement control on each native platform/backend tuple being qualified.
Record direct-DXF and DWG-converter handoff as separate operations with intermediate DXF identity and importer settings.
Keep dxflib callbacks and BRL-CAD faceted output scoped to their documented observations; do not use them as whole-document parity votes.
Continue local fast implementation slices without waiting for these optional external consumer observations.

validation.notes: jq empty and scoped git diff --check passed. No local test, peer executable, converter, or native CAD route is in scope for this research-only plan update.
